hooks.name: Check levels or run fast tests after an edit
hooks.description: After every tool call, tools/hooks/on-edit.mjs looks at write tools only: an edit to levels/*.json runs the level check, an edit to src/ or tests/ runs the fast tests, anything else passes silently. No matcher, because Kiro CLI's tool names differ from the documented categories.

hooks.name: Same check on file-save events
hooks.description: Covers clients where the file-save trigger fires (for example the IDE). The script checks the same edit only once if both triggers fire.
